Laura & Oriol

4th June 2027 · Ca n'Alzina, Igualada

From Barcelona to Darmstadt, we took a leap together and found a second place to call home. Since then, we’ve travelled from Japan to Iceland, through Europe and all the way to Costa Rica, sharing so many adventures and discovering new places together.

Now it’s time to bring together the two places we call home (🇪🇸 🇩🇪) and begin our greatest adventure yet, surrounded by the people we love most. We couldn’t imagine starting this next chapter without you.
